metadata.title: Clicked like I’m allergic to aiming and somehow popped 1 dude? Valorant logic is broken again
metadata.description:
Me: pressing random keys like a confused squirrel
Enemy: probably rethinking their life choices
Valorant just handed me a kill out of pure chaos
Click if your aim ever ghosts you, then delivers!

Smash that like if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
